summary.text: Lydia Glaize is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 67 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former elected official of the City of Fairburn, she lives in Fairburn, Georgia.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a former elected official of the City of Fairburn, the mother of seven children and the first college graduate in her family.
Glaize succeeded Micah Gravley in District 67, assuming office on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, the Education Committee and the House Higher Education Committee.
In her 2022 survey, she said she would promote educational recovery strategies and support fully funded public schools.
